$comment: Background library (3.4.0). Generated by scripts/dev/make-bg-library.py — edit recipes there, not here. A shot picks one by `bg` in manifests/shots.json (full id 'journal/ruled' or short 'ruled'); without `bg` resolve-shots rotates through the entries whose roles include the shot's role, never repeating the previous shot. Checked by scripts/validate-backgrounds.py (source + licence + sha256 + light + subtitle contrast).
